name: Echoing Strike
description: Land one palm and let the same qi ring again through the target a heartbeat later.

name: Unending Guard
description: Hold a guard whose qi refills as quickly as the blows against it spend it.

name: Ceaseless Step
description: Chain short steps without a pause between them so the body never stands still long enough to be struck.

name: Stacking Palm
description: Press palm after palm on one spot so each blow rides on the force the last one left behind.

name: Lengthening Reach
description: Send the qi of a punch on past the fist as a thin line that keeps travelling.

name: Looping Breath
description: Loop the breath into a cycle that returns its own qi so the user tires more slowly.

name: Compounding Fist
description: Throw a punch that carries a little of the force of every punch thrown before it in the exchange.

name: Rising Tally
description: Keep a running count of clean blows so that the qi behind each new one grows by a small step.

name: Repeating Jab
description: Drive two fingers into the same spot again and again so the point sinks deeper with each stroke.

name: Fastening Ward
description: Lay a ward of qi over the forearms that thickens a little with each blow it takes.

name: Fold Parry
description: Fold one parry into the next in a single flowing wave so a flurry slides past the guard.

name: Widening Ring
description: Stamp the ground and let a ring of force keep widening outward from the heel.

name: Running Count
description: Count the beat between the opponent's blows to learn the rhythm they are about to repeat.

name: Boundless Thrust
description: Extend the arm in a straight thrust and keep feeding qi forward so the reach grows past the arm.

name: Pellet Flick
description: Flick a bead of qi that does not slow or fade as it travels toward a distant target.

name: Outstretched Palm
description: Hold a palm out at full reach and let the qi lengthen the strike until it lands.

name: Looping Step
description: Spiral around the opponent in a loop of steps that never settles into a line they can read.

name: Stretching Guard
description: Pull a guard of qi outward from the arms so it covers a wider space without thinning.

name: Long Pull
description: Loose a line of qi to a target's sleeve and haul on it with force that never tires.

name: Relentless Fist
description: Throw fist after fist in a steady stream without letting the force of any single punch fade.

name: Tireless Frame
description: Spread qi through the muscles of the user or a near ally so strain builds more slowly.

name: Lingering Edge
description: Chop with an edge-hand whose qi stays on the wound and keeps pressing after the hand has gone.

name: Renewed Stance
description: Reset the stance a hair before each blow lands so the guard begins fresh every time.

name: Linked Blows
description: Link a chain of short blows so that each one starts exactly where the last one ended.

name: Unflagging Step
description: Press on at an even pace with qi feeding the legs so no step is slower than the last.

name: Mounting Pressure
description: Lean qi on an opponent's guard in steady increasing weight until the arms begin to sink.
